title: How Bicycles Evolved 🚲 From No Pedals to E-Bikes #shorts #engineering
description:
The first bicycle had no pedals at all. From Karl Drais' 1817 running machine to the boneshaker, the penny-farthing, the 1885 safety bicycle, air-filled tires and today's carbon and electric bikes. Follow for more How It Evolved!
